newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AUSTRIA'S TOPCALL OFFERS SHARES, TRADES ON EASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRIA'S TOPCALL OFFERS SHARES, TRADES ON EASDAQ.

text.p: Austrian messaging company Topcall International AG said on Sunday that it will make a private offering of shares and start trading on Easdaq, the small-capitalisation Brussels-based market, on July 11.

Topcall said in a statement it would make an initial offering of 40,000 new shares and that its majority shareholder would offer an additional 143,000 shares, both through private placements in Europe. It did not disclose the name of the shareholder.
Topcall, a supplier of professional electronic communications systems, said Easdaq gave trading approval on May 28. It added it would be the first issue on Easdaq with a free float above 50 percent.
Another Austrian firm, Schoeller-Bleckmann Oilfield Equipment AG, was also listed on Easdaq earlier this month.
Topcall was created in 1978 and has its headquarters in Vienna. In 1996 it had a turnover of 210 million schillings and operating profits of 52 million schillings, the statement said.

It added that the company has over 20 percent of the market share for fax servers in Europe, with a large percentage of such systems being installed at banks and other financial institutions. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876830
